finding: The commonest placental histomorphometric parameters/lesions in HIV-positive mothers were acute chorioamnionitis, acute umbilical phlebitis, and acute intervillositis.
mod_finding: The test group delivered more through cesarean section than the control group (52.1% vs. 31.3%).
birth_weight: Mean birth weights of 2.8±0.7 kg for HIV-positive mothers and 3.1±0.6 kg for HIV-negative mothers
